name: Novu Cloud Free
free_limit: 10,000 notification workflow runs/month, up to 20 workflows, 2 environments (development and production), 3 team members, and email/in-app/SMS/chat/push channels; no card required.
watch_out: Activity feed retained 24 hours and Novu branding applies. Pro/Team unlock higher volume and retention; downstream SMS, email or push providers may charge separately. Commercial-use contract terms should be confirmed; the self-hosted Enterprise offering is distinct.
